text: Good bits: 'probably limestone' / 'probably Danish.' The cat sitting on the correspondence. One signature plus a pawprint. Budget projections through 2045. The piece knows its best jokes. My issue is the ratio -- there's a lot of academic voice between the laughs and the voice itself, while well done, isn't inherently funny. It's the gap between the voice and the reality that's funny, and that gap only opens at certain moments. Could lose 800 words and be sharper.
